test_cases.title: Build Packet From Caller-Provided Inputs
test_cases.setup: Initialize telem_lib with a caller-owned output buffer. Construct a representative TELEM_INPUT_T with non-default values for every field.
procedure: Populate the input struct with deterministic non-zero values for timestamp, phase, GPS fix, baro altitude, nav state, voltage, validity, and health.
Call the telem_lib build function passing the input struct and output buffer.
Capture the returned status and produced byte length.
Decode the produced buffer using a reference parser fixture.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Build call returns JUNO_STATUS_SUCCESS and decoded packet fields equal the input struct fields exactly.

test_cases.title: Serialization Writes Only To Caller Buffer
test_cases.setup: Allocate a caller-owned byte buffer surrounded by guard regions filled with a sentinel pattern (0xA5).
procedure: Pre-fill guard bytes before and after the output buffer with 0xA5.
Invoke the telem_lib build function with the bounded buffer.
Read the guard regions after the call and compare against the sentinel pattern.
Read the buffer interior and verify it has been written.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Guard bytes remain 0xA5 (no out-of-bounds writes) and the buffer interior contains the serialized packet.

test_cases.title: Packet Includes All Required Content Fields
test_cases.setup: Build a packet from an input struct in which timestamp, phase, GPS fix, baro altitude, nav state, voltage, validity, and health each carry a unique sentinel value.
procedure: Populate each required input field with a distinct sentinel value.
Call the telem_lib build function.
Decode the produced buffer with the reference parser.
Assert that every required field is present and equal to its sentinel.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Decoded packet contains timestamp, phase, GPS fix, baro altitude, nav state, voltage, validity, and health, each matching its sentinel value.

test_cases.title: Serialized Size Within Configured Maximum
test_cases.setup: Read the telem_lib configured maximum packet size constant. Allocate a buffer exactly equal to that maximum.
procedure: Build a packet using maximum-magnitude inputs (e.g., max int values, all health bits set).
Capture the produced byte length from the build call.
Compare the produced length to the configured maximum size.
Repeat the build with several distinct input sets representative of flight ranges.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Produced byte length is less than or equal to the configured maximum for every tested input set.

test_cases.title: Buffer Smaller Than Packet Returns Error
test_cases.setup: Allocate an output buffer one byte smaller than the minimum encoded packet size. Place 0xA5 sentinels around it.
procedure: Provide the undersized buffer to the telem_lib build function.
Capture the returned status.
Verify guard bytes remain 0xA5.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Build returns a non-success JUNO_STATUS_T error code and guard bytes are unmodified.

test_cases.title: Integrity Field Validates Unmodified Packet
test_cases.setup: Build a packet from a representative input struct.
procedure: Call the telem_lib build function and obtain the output buffer.
Locate the integrity field at its documented offset.
Recompute the expected integrity value over the packet contents.
Compare the embedded integrity value with the recomputed value.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Embedded integrity field is non-zero and matches the value recomputed over the packet contents.

test_cases.title: Integrity Field Detects Single-Bit Corruption
test_cases.setup: Build a valid packet into a caller-owned buffer.
procedure: Build a packet and capture its byte length.
Flip a single bit in the packet payload (not the integrity field).
Recompute the integrity value over the corrupted contents.
Compare against the embedded integrity value.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Recomputed integrity value differs from the embedded integrity field after a single-bit flip.

test_cases.title: Packet Produced Across All Flight Phases
test_cases.setup: Enumerate all flight phase enum values defined for the telemetry packet.
procedure: For each phase value, populate the input struct with that phase.
Call the telem_lib build function.
Capture the returned status and decoded phase field.
Repeat for every defined phase.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Build returns JUNO_STATUS_SUCCESS for every phase and the decoded phase field equals the input phase.

test_cases.title: Sensor Health Bitmap Round-Trip
test_cases.setup: Prepare a set of distinct health bitmap values: 0x00000000, 0xFFFFFFFF, walking-ones pattern, walking-zeros pattern.
procedure: For each bitmap value, populate the input struct health field.
Call the telem_lib build function.
Decode the produced buffer.
Compare the decoded health field with the input value.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Decoded health bitmap equals the input health bitmap exactly for every tested value.

test_cases.title: Monotonic Microsecond Timestamp Round-Trip
test_cases.setup: Prepare a set of timestamp values: 0, 1, mid-range, and the maximum representable microsecond value.
procedure: For each timestamp value, populate the input struct timestamp field.
Call the telem_lib build function.
Decode the produced buffer.
Compare the decoded timestamp with the input value.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Decoded timestamp equals the input timestamp exactly for every tested value, including the boundary values.

test_cases.title: Deterministic Output For Identical Inputs
test_cases.setup: Allocate two separate caller-owned output buffers of equal size.
procedure: Construct one TELEM_INPUT_T struct with representative values.
Call the telem_lib build function with the input and the first buffer.
Call the telem_lib build function again with the same input and the second buffer.
Compare the two buffers byte-by-byte over the produced length.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Both buffers contain identical bytes over the produced length for identical inputs.

test_cases.title: Different Inputs Produce Different Output
test_cases.setup: Construct two TELEM_INPUT_T structs that differ only in a single field (e.g., timestamp).
procedure: Build a packet from the first input struct into buffer A.
Build a packet from the second input struct into buffer B.
Compare the two buffers byte-by-byte.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Buffers A and B differ in at least the bytes corresponding to the changed field, confirming the field is encoded.

test_cases.title: Golden Vector Wire Format Stability
test_cases.setup: Embed a fixed golden TELEM_INPUT_T and the corresponding reference golden byte vector in the test fixture.
procedure: Build a packet from the embedded golden input struct.
Compare the produced byte buffer against the embedded golden byte vector.
Run the test on the POSIX host build of telem_lib.
Run the same test compiled for the Pico2 target via the cross-build test harness.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Produced bytes match the golden vector exactly on both POSIX and Pico2 builds.

test_cases.title: No UART Or Radio I/O Performed
test_cases.setup: Static inspection fixture: review libs/telem_lib sources and link against a stub harness that exposes no UART or radio symbols.
procedure: Grep libs/telem_lib sources for symbols matching uart, lora, radio, and printf.
Confirm the telem_lib_test target links successfully without any UART or radio drivers.
Run the build_packet test under the link harness and confirm no I/O symbol is referenced.
Record the grep output and link map in the test log.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: No UART or radio API calls appear in libs/telem_lib sources and the test target links with zero unresolved I/O symbols.

test_cases.title: Navigation Validity Flag Round-Trip
test_cases.setup: Prepare two input structs identical except that one has nav validity = false and the other nav validity = true.
procedure: Build a packet from the validity=false input struct.
Decode the buffer and read the validity field.
Build a packet from the validity=true input struct.
Decode the buffer and read the validity field.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Decoded validity field equals false in the first case and true in the second case.

test_cases.title: Null Buffer Pointer Returns Error
procedure: Call the telem_lib build function passing a null output buffer pointer.
Capture the returned status.
Confirm no crash occurs and the function returns to the caller.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Build returns a non-success JUNO_STATUS_T error code without crashing.
